memory.err.already_retagged: the memory's tags are already changed
memory.err.auto_kind: %w: an automation does not apply %s by itself (only %s); propose it instead
memory.err.check_kind_title: %w: check the kind (%s) and the title (one line, up to 200 characters)
memory.err.confirm_words: a writer other than the person confirms a candidate only with the user's words (userQuote); otherwise evidence confirms it
memory.err.correction_quote: %w: a correction needs the user's words
memory.err.duplicate_proposal: the same proposal already exists or was rejected
memory.err.experiment_verdict: %w: an experiment verdict is helped, harmful or no_effect
memory.err.file_abs_path: %w: the file to apply must be an absolute path
memory.err.file_changed: the file changed after the proposal was made; let the retrospective propose again or fix it by hand
memory.err.file_no_edit: %w: a file proposal cannot be approved with edits; reject it and fix the file by hand
memory.err.flag_candidate: %w: only a candidate is marked as conflicting (%s)
memory.err.judgment_attach: the decision was applied but could not be attached to the judgment record: %w
memory.err.ledger_write: the change was applied but could not be recorded in the ledger: %w
memory.err.lesson_verdict: %w: a lesson attaches to one helped or harmful verdict that has evidence
memory.err.link_kind_origin: %w: the link kind is %s and the creator is ai, retro or user
memory.err.link_no_edit: %w: a link proposal cannot be approved with edits; approve it, then fix the basis with memory_update
memory.err.link_self: %w: a memory cannot be linked to itself
memory.err.memory_changed: the memory changed again after the change to revert; check the history and fix it by hand
memory.err.merge_gone: the memory to merge was already settled another way
memory.err.merge_needs: %w: at least two memories to merge and a merged title are required
memory.err.need_ids_or_from: %w: memory ids to tag or tags to remove (fromTags) are required
memory.err.need_old_new: %w: the memory to replace and the memory that replaces it (two different ids) are required
memory.err.need_one_memory: %w: one memory to edit is required
memory.err.need_target_id: %w: the target memory id is required
memory.err.need_two_memories: %w: two different memories to link are required
memory.err.no_evidence: no evidence to confirm automatically (another day, followed in verified work, or a project fact the work verified); it waits as a candidate
memory.err.not_in_ledger: %w: no such change in the ledger: %s
memory.err.not_topic_tag: %w: %q is not a topic tag (marker tags and kind names are not changed)
memory.err.nothing_to_revert: %w: this change has nothing to revert (%s)
memory.err.observe_days: %w: the observation period is at least 1 day
memory.err.proposal_kind_title: %w: a proposal kind (%s) and a title are required
memory.err.protected: this memory holds the user's own words; only the user changes it, or bring the user's words (userQuote) that ask for the change
memory.err.retag_no_edit: %w: a tag proposal cannot be approved with edits; reject it and fix the tags by hand
memory.err.revert_no_edit: %w: a revert cannot be approved with edits
memory.err.scope_form: %w: the scope is global or project:<key>
memory.err.scope_is: %w: the scope is global or project:<key>
memory.err.source_kind: %w: the source kind is one of %s
memory.err.usage_verdict: %w: a usage verdict needs a memory id and one of %s
memory.err.verdict_title: %w: a verdict (%s) and a title are required
memory.err.version_conflict: it was changed elsewhere first; read it again and retry
memory.settled.merge_gone: the memory to merge was already settled another way
